_about: Pest/predator classes and decision thresholds. Values marked PLACEHOLDER must be confirmed with the ICAR-IIHR mentor before field use. Loaded by backend/src/services/pestConfig.js at startup.

decision._action_threshold_per_day: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with IIHR mentor. Average pests per trap per day (over the rolling window) that triggers action.
decision._spray_ratio: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with IIHR mentor. Pests per predator at or above which predators are NOT keeping pace -> SPRAY; below it -> RELEASE BIOCONTROL.
decision._rolling_window_days: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with IIHR mentor. How many of the most recent days with counts are averaged.
decision._count_uncertainty: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with the trained model's evaluation. Relative +/- uncertainty of a count when detection confidence is unknown; with confidence c it is (1 - c), clamped to [min, max] below.
